summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a small Jest CLI wrapper but ships a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that fetches the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun (v1.3.13) at install time, extracts and chmods the binary, and then invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style identifiers), and math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line obfuscator.io-shaped blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header plus a `WV8StW` string-array rotation routine) whose behavior cannot be enumerated without dynamic execution. The purpose is mismatched: a ~28-line Jest CLI wrapper does not need the Bun runtime, and the only reason to use a freshly downloaded alternate runtime to execute a sibling script at install time is to run code outside Node's tooling and scanners. The install-time chain — fetch alternate runtime + execute bundled obfuscated payload with it, with no relationship to the advertised Jest wrapper functionality — matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and causes attacker-controlled bundled code to run on any machine performing `npm install` of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
